en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ali Bin Atiyya, from Khaysama, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is Distinct from His<sup>azwj</sup> creation and His<sup>azwj</sup> creation is distinct from Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and everything what the name ‘thing’ occurs upon, apart from Allah<sup>azwj</sup> the Exalted, so it is a creation, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> is the Creator of everything’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from Imam abu Ja‘far (a.s.) who said, “
Allah is distinct from His creatures and the creatures are different from Him and whatever could be called a thing is a creature except Allah Who is the Creator of all things.”
